# Victor Augusto

> Full Stack Developer (.NET/C#, React) based in Belo Horizonte, Brazil. Systems Analyst at Attime, working on banking integrations and payment gateway integrations for an insurance and financial services ERP.

Portfolio site available in Portuguese (default), English and Spanish. Graduating in Information Systems from Faculdade COTEMIG (2023–2026). Previously a Systems Development Analyst at GW Engenharia Clínica, working on a hospital/clinic management ERP.

## Projects

- [PersonalPay](https://victoraugusto.dev/#projects): recurring billing app with Pix QR code payments. [Source](https://github.com/victoraugustovalle/PersonalPay)
- [RachaContas](https://victoraugusto.dev/#projects): Telegram bot that splits group expenses automatically. [Source](https://github.com/victoraugustovalle/RachaContaBot)
- [LiveTranscribe](https://victoraugusto.dev/#projects): real-time audio transcription app. [Source](https://github.com/victoraugustovalle/LiveTranscribe)
- [HopePet](https://victoraugusto.dev/#projects): platform to reunite lost and found pets, using computer vision and geolocation. Commercial product in launch phase, source not public.
